description: Autobusu kustības saraksts starppilsētu un vietējās nozīmes maršrutos is a dataset listed in data.gov.lv, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by VSIA Autotransporta direkcija. List of intercity and local movements in CSV format. Coverage: VSIA Autotransporta direkcija. The portal shows the English title as "Bus schedule on interurban and local routes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is VSIA Autotransporta direkcija. Its keywords include ATD, Kustības saraksts, Autobuss, Autotransporta direkcija, Pietura, Pieturvieta. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-10-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lv.
